dedupe_keys.name: dsmr smart meter simulation and parsing toolkit

description: DSMR Toolkit is a Java collection for processing Dutch smart-meter P1-port messages. It includes a simulator that emits synthetic DSMR telegrams through a local named pipe, a stream splitter and parser, and adapters for NiFi, InfluxDB and GraphQL. Users supply live P1-port messages or use fake meter readings to test a collection pipeline. Outputs are parsed consumption records or a stream of simulated telegrams, depending on the component. The format is Dutch DSMR; a deployment outside that protocol would need adaptation. Apache-2.0 source and Maven artifacts are public. The maintainer says the software works in one home setup but remains at a 0.x stage and may make breaking changes. This is useful for testing meter-data ingestion before energy-demand or grid simulation. It is not an electricity-network solver; the related catalogue record for Low Carbon London smart meters is a distinct measured dataset. No meter readings, binary artifacts or package were downloaded.
